notes.title: v1.1.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
This update changes the game a little, but also makes it a little more intuitive to play. Here's what to look out for:

[list]
[*]The Sneeball and Aero Twirl moves can now be performed directly off of the ground.*

[*]Using the Sneeball move will now stop yielding points as well as stop counting toward bonus round progression if used exclusively in excess. Jumping on an enemy or using the Meteor Pounce move to defeat an enemy will revert it back to normal rules until this happens again. This is to prevent an exploit where Sneeball can be used to farm points indefinitely.

[*]Fixed a bug that would cause enemies to resume spawning if the bonus round was initiated while the freeze ability was active during the transition.

[*]Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the invincibility finale sound to play slightly disjointed from the main invincibility music once it completes.

[*]Holding the down button when skidding in the opposite direction that the player is facing on the ground no longer prevents a Pounce if the move is attempted.

[*]Minor improvements to Sneebles's collision impacting how close he has to be to push the burrito.

[*]Minor improvements to the tutorial, such as the special ability power-up bubbles being more clearly visible, a pause screen prompt to avoid confusion, and an on-screen background sign displaying how to ascend in the bonus round portion.

[*]Minor bug fixes and other improvements to presentation.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]A minor bug fix.
[*]Added functionality that allows users to return to the main menu by pressing the escape key when using keyboard controls or by pressing the B button when using a controller in addition to the on-screen menu buttons.
[*]Improved instruction accessibility by adding a moveset layout to the pause menu.
[*]Minor cutscene animation adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Info For Sneebles The Half Cat
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you checking out [i]Sneebles The Half Cat[/i]! For those curious about if this game is compatible with your Steam Deck, I am proud to announce that the game works natively with Steam Deck hardware right out of the box!

This game is still new, so getting an official mark regarding Steam Deck compatibility from Valve may take some time. In the interim, you have word from the developer that this game will work with your Steam Deck device. I have rigorously tested the game on my own personal Steam Deck and made sure this game will be ready to be played on it day one!

[u]Important Notes[/u] 
[list]
[*]Steam Cloud compatibility for this game currently will [b]NOT[/b] save data between devices running different operating systems. For example, if you have a high score saved on a PC running Windows, it will not transfer to your Steam Deck that is running Linux, and vice versa. Stay tuned for updates as further Steam Cloud compatibility may be added in the future.
[*] This game is locked at a 1920x1080 resolution. Likewise, black bars are drawn to fill the top and bottom of the Steam Deck's native 1280x800 resolution screen. This is commonplace for games that need to be displayed at 1080p and will not impact gameplay or visuals whatsoever.
[/list]

Thank you for playing, and have fun taking [i]Sneebles[/i] anywhere you go!
